sahneler.metin: The Leaning Tower of Pisa was closed because it was falling over.
Its lean kept growing until collapse became a real risk.
Its foundation was shallow, and the soil beneath was soft and uneven.
One side sank more than the other.
Engineers carefully removed soil from under the high side.
The tower settled back slightly and stopped moving.
It reopened, still leaning, but stable.

aciklama:
Leaning Tower of Pisa was closed because it was leaning toward collapse. The cause: differential settlement of a shallow foundation in soft clay.
